name: Hitome Kyouta
source:
One of the founding members of the Shadow Glove Troupe, a local theater group. 
Kyota has played a wide range of roles in his time, and though his acrobatic skills are top notch, he has yet to find any real fame as an actor. 
He refers to himself as "The All-Seeing Eye" and often gets carried away with over-the-top theatrics. Throughout all of this, however, he still manages to speak in a reasonable, respectful manner.
translation:
One of the founding members of the Shadow Glove Troupe, a local theater group. 
Kyota has played a wide range of roles in his time, and though his acrobatic skills are top notch, he has yet to find any real fame as an actor. 
He refers to himself as "The All-Seeing Eye" and often gets carried away with over-the-top theatrics. Throughout all of this, however, he still manages to speak in a reasonable, respectful manner.
